question: What will the front-month Brent crude futures settlement price be on October 16, 2026 (USD/barrel)?

calls.reasoning: Status quo: the December Brent contract (CBZ26) is front month at about $101-103 on Oct 5 (TE 101.31; it was 98.03 on Sep 30). The reference class is 9-trading-day changes in front-month Brent during the 2026 US-Iran/Hormuz conflict regime. That regime saw swings like 104->74 (Jun) and 72->100+ (Jul), which implies about 45-50% annualized vol, or roughly a $9 SD over the horizon. I centre the median at the current price, close to a martingale. There are tail risks both ways: an escalation such as Houthi strikes on Aramco or a third US carrier group, and a de-escalation through a US-Iran deal plus the G7 release of 100M barrels from reserves. No human market matches the contract: Polymarket has Brent perpetuals but no Oct 16 settlement contract, Kalshi focuses on WTI, and nothing was found on Manifold.
